subject.title: Feature: --agent flag for TUI to select which agent handles the session

question: Should TUI add a separate `--agent <id>` convenience flag when `--session agent:<id>:<session>` already selects that agent at startup?
rationale: The routing capability already exists, so adding another public CLI selector is an API and ergonomics choice rather than a missing runtime primitive.

options.title: Keep one canonical selector
options.body: Improve CLI help and examples for agent-scoped `--session` keys without adding a parallel public option.

options.title: Add a convenience alias
options.body: Implement `--agent` as validated shorthand and reject or clearly resolve conflicts with agent-scoped `--session`, cwd inference, and remembered selection.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep the request open until TUI startup ergonomics receive a broader maintainer design pass.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical selector
recommendation.body: Improve CLI help and examples for agent-scoped `--session` keys without adding a parallel public option.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to recent TUI implementation history and supplied the most recent item-specific assessment of this product choice.
